name: pageworks
description: Public-facing documentation skill — owns docs/ scaffold, schema, authoring, renderer export, and maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Pageworks owns everything inside a project's docs/ folder: scaffold, schema, page authoring with Diátaxis templates, renderer export to MkDocs Material and Docusaurus, drift detection, and maintenance as specs change. Standalone-capable on any project; pairs cleanly with spectacular for internal/external doc separation.
